sentences.en: This is crazy talk.

sentences.en: You're just making stuff up.

sentences.en: To prescribe a vaccine for children.

sentences.en: I'm not making things up.

sentences.en: Over his vaccine policies, his ouster of the director of the CDC, and the growing list of federal health officials who have resigned in protest of his leadership.
sentences.zh: 因为他的疫苗政策、他罢免疾控中心主任的行为，以及越来越多的联邦卫生官员因抗议他的领导而辞职。

sentences.zh: 每个人都是腐败的。

sentences.zh: 但你呢？

sentences.zh: 这就是我们所看到的吗？

sentences.zh: 我不这么认为。

sentences.zh: 我认为现在的问题是……

sentences.en: I don't even know what you're talking about.
sentences.zh: 我甚至不知道你在说什么。

sentences.en: My colleague, Cheryl Gay Stolbert, was in the room and describes what seems like a turning point in the relationship between Congress and Kennedy.
sentences.zh: 我的同事谢丽尔·盖伊·斯托尔伯格当时在场，她描述了国会与肯尼迪之间关系似乎出现的转折点。
zh_words: 谢丽尔·盖伊·斯托尔伯格

sentences.en: You are a hazard to the health of the American people.
sentences.zh: 你对美国人民的健康构成了危害。

sentences.en: Can I respond to that, sir?
sentences.zh: 我能回应一下吗，先生？

sentences.en: You, you, you, no, I'm...
sentences.zh: 你，你，你，不，我……

sentences.en: It's Friday, September 5th.
sentences.zh: 今天是9月5日，星期五。

sentences.en: Cheryl, this was a remarkable hearing.
sentences.zh: 谢丽尔，这是一场不同寻常的听证会。

sentences.en: Remarkable, I would say, for the level of anger in both directions, witness and senators.
sentences.zh: 之所以说它不同寻常，是因为证人和参议员双方都表现出了极大的愤怒。

sentences.en: Remarkable because of the accusations that were traded and the sheer number of times that people were called liars.
sentences.zh: 之所以说它不同寻常，是因为双方互相指责，而且人们被称为骗子的次数多得惊人。

sentences.en: And almost all of it stemmed from decisions that the Secretary of Health, Robert F.
sentences.zh: 几乎所有这些都源于卫生部长小罗伯特·F·

sentences.en: Kennedy Jr., has made around vaccines, especially in the past few weeks, and where that leaves public health in the United States.
sentences.zh: 肯尼迪在疫苗问题上所做的决定，尤其是在过去几周，以及这给美国公共卫生带来的后果。

sentences.en: It was extraordinary.
sentences.zh: 这太不寻常了。

sentences.en: First of all, it's very rare in the Capitol, if ever, to see a witness call a senator a liar.
sentences.zh: 首先，在国会大厦，证人称参议员为骗子的情况非常罕见，甚至前所未有。

sentences.en: And Kennedy comes from a very particular place, right?
sentences.zh: 而且肯尼迪有着非常特殊的背景，对吧？

sentences.en: He grew up in this Democratic family.
sentences.zh: 他在这个民主党家庭中长大。

sentences.en: He was playing in the Oval Office, you know, when he was a little boy and his Uncle John was president.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他小时候就在椭圆形办公室里玩耍，当时他的叔叔约翰是总统。

sentences.en: And he feels no compunction about treating these senators as his equal.
sentences.zh: 他对待这些参议员时毫无顾忌，把他们视为平起平坐的人。

sentences.en: He does not come seeking favors.
sentences.zh: 他不是来寻求恩惠的。

sentences.en: He comes lobbing insults.
sentences.zh: 他是来投掷侮辱性言论的。

sentences.en: Well, just give me the context, as you see it, in which this hearing arrives.
sentences.zh: 那么，请向我介绍一下你所看到的这场听证会发生的背景。

sentences.en: Well, it's been seven months since Kennedy was sworn in by President Trump as Health and Human Services Secretary.
sentences.zh: 嗯，距离肯尼迪被特朗普总统任命为卫生与公众服务部部长已经过去七个月了。

sentences.en: When he was confirmed, there was a lot of pause about him on the part of Democrats, but also some Republicans, about his views on vaccines.
sentences.zh: 当他获得确认时，民主党人，甚至一些共和党人，对他关于疫苗的观点都持保留意见。

sentences.en: Many people would call him anti-vaccine.
sentences.zh: 许多人会称他为反疫苗人士。

sentences.en: He insists he's not anti-vaccine.
sentences.zh: 他坚称自己不是反疫苗。

sentences.en: He's pro-safety.
sentences.zh: 他是支持安全的。

sentences.en: But nonetheless, senators were very concerned.
sentences.zh: 但尽管如此，参议员们还是非常担心。

sentences.en: And Kennedy made some very explicit promises.
sentences.zh: 而且肯尼迪做出了一些非常明确的承诺。

sentences.en: To get confirmed, right.
sentences.zh: 为了获得确认，对吧。

sentences.en: To get confirmed, he said he was not going to take away anybody's vaccines, and he was not going to discourage vaccination.
sentences.zh: 为了获得确认，他说他不会剥夺任何人的疫苗，也不会阻碍疫苗接种。

sentences.en: And that seems like a very important promise to have made for skeptical senators from both parties.
sentences.zh: 对于两党持怀疑态度的参议员来说，这似乎是一个非常重要的承诺。

sentences.en: Yes, very much so.
sentences.zh: 是的，确实如此。

sentences.en: But in the seven months since,
sentences.zh: 但在过去的七个月里，

sentences.en: Kennedy has issued a very lukewarm endorsement of the measles vaccine during a measles outbreak that is the worst in this country in 20 years.
sentences.zh: 在麻疹疫情爆发期间——这是该国20年来最严重的一次——肯尼迪对麻疹疫苗的支持却非常冷淡。

sentences.en: He canceled $500 million in government contracts for mRNA vaccines.
sentences.zh: 他取消了5亿美元的mRNA疫苗政府合同。

sentences.en: That's the technology that was used to create the COVID vaccines.
sentences.zh: 这就是用于制造新冠疫苗的技术。

sentences.en: Kennedy also announced that COVID vaccines would no longer be recommended for healthy children or adults under 65, which will make them effectively harder to get
sentences.zh: 肯尼迪还宣布，不再建议健康的儿童或65岁以下的成年人接种新冠疫苗，这将使他们实际上更难获得疫苗，

sentences.en: because some pharmacies will require prescriptions and some insurers might not insure them.
sentences.zh: 因为一些药店将要求处方，而一些保险公司可能不会承保。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: That's a major rollback in the government's recommendation for COVID vaccines.
sentences.zh: 这是政府在新冠疫苗建议上的重大倒退。

sentences.en: It is.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: And on top of that, he fired all 17 members of the panel of experts who advise the CDC on vaccine policy, and he replaced them with his own people,
sentences.zh: 不仅如此，他还解雇了所有17名向疾控中心提供疫苗政策建议的专家组成员，并换上了他自己的人，

sentences.en: many of whom are vaccine skeptics, like he is.
sentences.zh: 其中许多人和他一样，都是疫苗怀疑论者。

sentences.en: But the big thing, the thing that caused a huge uproar and chaos at the CDC is that last week,
sentences.zh: 但最重要的事情，那件在疾控中心引起轩然大波和混乱的事情是，上周，

sentences.en: Kennedy orchestrated the firing of the director of the CDC just one month after she had been confirmed by the Senate.
sentences.zh: 肯尼迪策划了解雇疾控中心主任的行动，而她才刚刚获得参议院确认一个月。

sentences.en: And the question among members of both parties is, did all of this amount to Kennedy breaking his promise not to make it harder for Americans to get vaccines?
sentences.zh: 两党成员都在问，这一切是否意味着肯尼迪违背了他不让美国人更难获得疫苗的承诺？

sentences.en: And that's the context in which this hearing played out.
sentences.zh: 这就是这场听证会展开的背景。

sentences.en: Well, Cheryl, take us inside this hearing room and describe how this hearing starts to unfold.
sentences.zh: 那么，谢丽尔，带我们进入听证会现场，描述一下听证会是如何开始的。

sentences.en: This hearing will come to order.
sentences.zh: 现在开会。

sentences.en: So this was a hearing before the Senate Finance Committee, which has jurisdiction over the Health and Human Services Department.
sentences.zh: 这是参议院财政委员会的听证会，该委员会对卫生与公众服务部拥有管辖权。

sentences.en: Today we meet to hear from U.S.
sentences.zh: 今天我们在此听取美国

sentences.en: Department of Health and Human Services Secretary Robert F.
sentences.zh: 卫生与公众服务部部长小罗伯特·F·

sentences.en: Kennedy, Jr.
sentences.zh: 肯尼迪的证词。

sentences.en: And it was ostensibly to give Kennedy a chance to testify on President Trump's 2026 budget proposal.
sentences.zh: 表面上是为了让肯尼迪有机会就特朗普总统的2026年预算提案作证。

sentences.en: Mr. Secretary, I look forward to hearing from you today about the administration's efforts to make America healthy again.
sentences.zh: 部长先生，我很期待今天听取您关于政府为让美国再次健康所做的努力。

sentences.en: But everybody knew that's not what it was really about.
sentences.zh: 但大家都知道，这并不是真正的议题。

sentences.en: It was always going to be about vaccines.
sentences.zh: 议题始终是疫苗。

sentences.en: It was always going to be about vaccines.
sentences.zh: 议题始终是疫苗。

sentences.en: Thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: Senator Wyden.
sentences.zh: 怀登参议员。

sentences.en: Right away, the Democrats came out swinging.
sentences.zh: 民主党人立刻发起了猛烈抨击。

sentences.en: Thank you, Mr. Chairman.
sentences.zh: 谢谢主席先生。

sentences.en: As the committee gathers today, the United States is in the midst of a health care calamity.
sentences.zh: 在委员会今天召开会议之际，美国正处于一场医疗灾难之中。

sentences.en: Ron Wyden, the top Democrat on the committee, kicked things off.
sentences.zh: 委员会中级别最高的民主党人罗恩·怀登率先发言。

sentences.en: It's been obvious from the start that Robert Kennedy's primary interest is to take vaccines away from Americans.
sentences.zh: 从一开始就很明显，小罗伯特·肯尼迪的主要兴趣是剥夺美国人的疫苗。

sentences.en: During his confirmation process, he claimed to be pro-safety and pro-science, but his actions reveal a steadfast commitment to elevating junk science and fringe conspiracies.
sentences.zh: 在确认过程中，他声称自己支持安全和科学，但他的行为揭示了他对推崇伪科学和边缘阴谋论的坚定承诺。

sentences.en: He right away goes through this long list of things that he says Kennedy has done to endanger the health of all Americans.
sentences.zh: 他立刻列举了肯尼迪所做的危害所有美国人健康的一长串事情。

sentences.en: Families are confused.
sentences.zh: 家庭感到困惑。

sentences.en: They're scared about who to trust about their health care.
sentences.zh: 他们害怕在医疗保健方面该信任谁。

sentences.en: Not only that, he accused Kennedy of lying to the committee previously.
sentences.zh: 不仅如此，他还指责肯尼迪之前对委员会撒谎。

sentences.en: I think it is unfortunate that I have to do this, but given the unprecedented nature of the witness's behavior,
sentences.zh: 我认为我不得不这样做很不幸，但鉴于证人行为的前所未有，

sentences.en: I would ask now that the committee formally swear in Robert Kennedy as a witness.
sentences.zh: 我现在要求委员会正式让罗伯特·肯尼迪宣誓作证。

sentences.en: And took the extraordinary step of saying he wanted Kennedy sworn in formally so that he would have to vow to tell the truth under oath.
sentences.zh: 并采取了非常手段，要求肯尼迪正式宣誓，这样他就必须发誓在宣誓下说真话。

sentences.en: Isn't that kind of a presumed state of testifying before Congress?
sentences.zh: 在国会作证不是默认需要宣誓吗？

sentences.en: What exactly is Wyden asking for?
sentences.zh: 怀登到底在要求什么？

sentences.en: Well, it was kind of an insult to Kennedy, frankly.
sentences.zh: 坦率地说，这有点侮辱肯尼迪。

sentences.en: It is a presumed state, and once someone is a cabinet secretary, it is presumed that they are going to come in and testify truthfully.
sentences.zh: 这确实是默认状态，一旦某人成为内阁部长，就默认他们会来如实作证。

sentences.en: Wyden is, in effect, telling Kennedy and his colleagues, I don't believe you're going to be truthful with us.
sentences.zh: 怀登实际上是在告诉肯尼迪和他的同事们：我不相信你会对我们说实话。

sentences.en: Senator Wyden, I will personally object and will reject your requeSt.
sentences.zh: 怀登参议员，我个人反对并拒绝你的请求。

sentences.en: We will treat this witness as we treat all of the other administration witnesses who come before us.
sentences.zh: 我们将像对待所有其他出席听证会的政府证人一样对待这位证人。

sentences.en: And the chairman of the committee, Mike Crapo, Republican of Idaho, immediately shot it down and said, no, we're not doing that.
sentences.zh: 委员会主席、来自爱达荷州的共和党人迈克·克拉波立即驳回了这一要求，并表示，不，我们不会那样做。

sentences.en: But Wyden just went on and continued to press Kennedy and put him on the spot.
sentences.zh: 但怀登继续施压肯尼迪，让他陷入困境。

sentences.en: Thank you very much, Mr. Chairman.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢，主席先生。

sentences.en: I've made it clear.
sentences.zh: 我已经说得很清楚了。

sentences.en: I think that Secretary Kennedy is dead set on making it harder for children to get vaccines and that kids are going to die because of it.
sentences.zh: 我认为肯尼迪部长铁了心要让孩子们更难获得疫苗，而孩子们会因此而死亡。

sentences.en: And this really set the tone for the hearing.
sentences.zh: 这确实为听证会定下了基调。

sentences.en: I hope that you will tell the American people how many preventable child deaths are an acceptable sacrifice
sentences.zh: 我希望你能告诉美国人民，有多少可预防的儿童死亡是可以接受的牺牲，

sentences.en: for enacting an agenda that I think is fundamentally cruel and defies common sense.
sentences.zh: 为了实施一项我认为从根本上是残酷且违背常识的议程。

sentences.en: Thank you, Mr. Chairman.
sentences.zh: 谢谢，主席先生。

sentences.en: Do I get a reply?
sentences.zh: 我可以回应吗？

sentences.en: And if Kennedy wasn't angry when he walked into the room, he was certainly angry after this.
sentences.zh: 如果肯尼迪走进房间时还不生气，那么在这之后他肯定生气了。

sentences.en: Senator, you've sat in that chair for how long?
sentences.zh: 参议员，你坐在那个位置上多久了？

sentences.en: 20, 25 years while the chronic disease in our children went up to 76 percent.
sentences.zh: 20年、25年，而我们儿童的慢性病发病率上升到了76%。

sentences.en: And you said nothing.
sentences.zh: 而你什么都没说。

sentences.en: You never asked the question why it's happening.
sentences.zh: 你从来没有问过为什么会发生这种情况。

sentences.en: Why is this happening?
sentences.zh: 为什么会这样？

sentences.en: And Kennedy's response to Wyden, Cheryl, and this comes up many times in this hearing, especially when it comes to the Democrats,
sentences.zh: 谢丽尔，肯尼迪对怀登的回应——在这次听证会中多次出现，特别是在面对民主党人时——

sentences.en: is that in Kennedy's mind, senators responsible for overseeing America's health care system have allowed America to become a sicker and sicker country over time.
sentences.zh: 在肯尼迪看来，负责监督美国医疗体系的参议员们任由美国随着时间的推移变得越来越病态。

sentences.en: And therefore, in Kennedy's mind, have failed to do their job.
sentences.zh: 因此，在肯尼迪看来，他们没有尽到自己的职责。

sentences.en: In his telling, they've upheld a bad status quo, which he says he's trying to fix.
sentences.zh: 在他看来，他们维护了一个糟糕的现状，而他说他正在努力修复它。

sentences.en: And part of that is by questioning who gets what vaccine and if they really need it.
sentences.zh: 其中一部分就是质疑谁该接种什么疫苗，以及他们是否真的需要接种。

sentences.en: Yes, I would add to that.
sentences.zh: 是的，我还要补充一点。

sentences.en: And I would say in Kennedy's mind, the CDC has presided over a rise in chronic disease.
sentences.zh: 我想说，在肯尼迪看来，疾控中心主导了慢性病的上升。

sentences.en: If we don't end this chronic disease, we are the sickest country in the world.
sentences.zh: 如果我们不结束这种慢性病，我们就是世界上最病态的国家。

sentences.en: That's why we have to fire people at the CDC.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么我们必须解雇疾控中心的人。

sentences.en: And it's the CDC that needs to be cleared out and reorganized because they have failed Americans.
sentences.zh: 正是疾控中心需要被清理和重组，因为他们辜负了美国人。

sentences.en: And the senators who oversaw the CDC were complicit in that failure.
sentences.zh: 而监督疾控中心的参议员们也是这种失败的同谋。

sentences.en: They did not do their job.
sentences.zh: 他们没有尽到自己的职责。

sentences.en: This was their job to keep us healthy.
sentences.zh: 保持我们的健康是他们的职责。

sentences.en: But what becomes clear is that the Democrats on this committee don't really want to have that conversation about the CDC, about chronic illness in this country,
sentences.zh: 但显而易见的是，委员会里的民主党人并不真的想讨论关于疾控中心、关于这个国家的慢性病的问题，

sentences.en: at least not in this moment.
sentences.zh: 至少在这一刻不想。

sentences.en: They want to keep talking about what they see as Kennedy's broken promises on vaccines.
sentences.zh: 他们想继续谈论他们所认为的肯尼迪在疫苗问题上违背的承诺。

sentences.en: Thank you, Mr. Chairman.
sentences.zh: 谢谢，主席先生。

sentences.en: So...
sentences.zh: 那么……

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。
